src: monochrome path-like column groups s separated by all-background columns, ordered left to right
dst: adjacent packed column slots d in the same left-to-right order
transform: remove separator columns; keep the first group at its original vertical offset, then paste each later group shifted vertically so its left degree-1 edge endpoint touches the previous placed group's right degree-1 edge endpoint
multi_step: after each placement, that group's right endpoint row becomes the connector row for the next group
grid_shape: same height as input; width is the sum of the non-background column-group widths
